description: This file defines API endpoints related to user information within a FastAPI application, including current user profile retrieval, user's recipes, and favorite recipes. It includes helper functions for serialization and interacts with database models and schemas.

methods.name: UserOut read_me(current_user: models.User = Depends(get_current_active_user))
methods.description: Returns the profile of the current authenticated user.

methods.name: RecipeOut _serialize_recipe_with_favorite(recipe: models.Recipe, db: Session, user_id: int)
methods.description: Serializes a recipe including whether it is marked as favorite by the user.

methods.name: list[RecipeOut] my_recipes( current_user: models.User = Depends(get_current_active_user), db: Session = Depends(db_session), )
methods.description: Retrieves the list of recipes created by the current user.

methods.name: list[RecipeOut] my_favorites( current_user: models.User = Depends(get_current_active_user), db: Session = Depends(db_session), )
methods.description: Retrieves the list of recipes favorited by the current user.
